arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS diff FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID" HAVING ABS(SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT"))>0.001

SELECT h."INV_ID", h."VEND_CD", h."INV_NO", h."INV_AMT", h."STAT_CD", h."INV_DT", j."JRNL_NO", (SELECT SUM(l."DR_AMT")-SUM(l."CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO") AS jdiff FROM "APINVH" h LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."INV_AMT" < 0 OR h."INV_AMT" IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT SUM(l."DR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") IN (SELECT TRIM("ACCT_CD") FROM "GLCOA" WHERE "ACTV_FLG" IS NOT NULL) AND l."DR_AMT"<>0 AND 1=0)

SELECT h."INV_ID", h."VEND_CD", h."INV_NO", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS jr_dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS jr_cr FROM "APINVH" h LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" GROUP BY h."INV_ID", h."VEND_CD", h."INV_NO", h."INV_AMT", h."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(COALESCE(SUM(l."CR_AMT"),0) - h."INV_AMT") > 0.001 OR ABS(COALESCE(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),0) - h."INV_AMT") > 0.001

SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) AS vk, LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM("INV_NO")),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') AS ik, COUNT(*) AS n, ARRAY_AGG("INV_ID") AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT p."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" IS NULL OR h."POST_DT"=0 OR h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" OR (p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT")
